meta.title: 这个人的打腿方式好特别
meta.title_en: This Person's Kicking Style Is Something Else
meta.topic: 游泳技术 · 打腿方式

scenes.context: 视频展示的传统鞭状打腿：髋发力、膝微弯、踝放松。这是自由泳打腿的基础形态，鞭状传导。语域：游泳技术，动作展示。
sentences: 传统的鞭状打腿，髋发力。
The traditional whip kick is hip-driven.
hip-driven（髋发力）
膝盖微微弯曲，脚踝放松。
Knees slightly bent, ankles relaxed.
ankles relaxed（脚踝放松）
鞭状传导，从髋到脚。
The whip travels from hip to foot.
the whip travels（鞭状传导）
paraphrase: 鞭状打腿 → whip kick / whipping kick
髋发力 → hip-driven / power from the hips
scenes.speak: The traditional whip kick is hip-driven. Knees slightly bent, ankles relaxed. The whip travels from hip to foot.

scenes.context: 接下来展示一种特殊打腿：发力节奏与常规方式明显不同。这种节奏差异正是视频标题「好特别」的由来。语域：游泳技术，对比展示。
sentences: 这种特殊打腿，发力节奏很不一样。
This special kicking has a distinctly different rhythm.
distinctly different（明显不同）
节奏差异，就是「特别」的所在。
That rhythm shift is what makes it special.
rhythm shift（节奏差异）
打腿方式好特别。
The kicking style is something else.
something else（好特别）
paraphrase: 发力节奏 → power rhythm / the timing of the drive
power rhythm · timing of the drive
好特别 → something else / one of a kind
something else · one of a kind
scenes.speak: This special kicking has a distinctly different rhythm. That rhythm shift is what makes it special. The kicking style is something else.

scenes.context: 侧面视角清晰展示腿部运动轨迹和幅度。侧视最能看出打腿的幅度大小与轨迹是否流畅。语域：游泳技术，视角分析。
sentences: 侧面视角，看得最清楚。
The side view shows everything clearly.
the side view（侧面视角）
腿部运动轨迹，一目了然。
The leg's movement path is easy to follow.
movement path（运动轨迹）
幅度大小，决定推进效率。
Range of motion decides propulsive efficiency.
propulsive efficiency（推进效率）
paraphrase: 运动轨迹 → movement path / the path of the kick
movement path · path of the kick
幅度 → range of motion / the amplitude
scenes.speak: The side view shows everything clearly. The leg's movement path is easy to follow. Range of motion decides propulsive efficiency.

scenes.context: 完整游进时观察打腿推进力和身体位置，收尾展示整体动作的流畅度。打腿的推进力与身体姿态在完整配合中体现。语域：游泳技术，收尾展示。
sentences: 完整游进，观察打腿推进力。
In full swimming, watch the kick's propulsion.
the kick's propulsion（打腿推进力）
身体位置保持平稳。
The body position stays smooth and level.
stays smooth and level（保持平稳）
整体动作，非常流畅。
The whole motion flows beautifully.
flows beautifully（非常流畅）
paraphrase: 流畅 → flows / smooth and continuous
scenes.speak: In full swimming, watch the kick's propulsion. The body position stays smooth and level. The whole motion flows beautifully.

practice: The traditional whip kick is hip-driven.
This special kicking has a distinctly different rhythm.
The side view shows everything clearly.
In full swimming, watch the kick's propulsion.
pitfalls: The traditional whip kick is hip-driven.
It has a distinctly different rhythm.
The leg's movement path is easy to follow.
「运动轨迹」用 movement path，不是 trail。
shifts: 用 whip kick（鞭状打腿）、hip-driven（髋发力）、power rhythm（发力节奏）
用 propulsion（推进力）、movement path（运动轨迹）、range of motion（幅度）
用 ankles relaxed（脚踝放松）、knees slightly bent（膝微弯）、flows beautifully（流畅）
footer_notes: 本视频无口播，场景数据基于图文实录的图片说明（figcaption）重建。已校正：鞭状打腿、髋发力、膝微弯、踝放松、发力节奏、侧面视角、运动轨迹、推进力、流畅度等。
